A little shop.
Room to grow.

Grow the goods. Welcome the neighborhood. Build your empire. Canopy is a cozy idle game set inside a living, isometric dispensary, and it plays right here in your browser.

Play free How it plays
  • Free
  • No account

  • Saves on your device

Tap a station. Watch the shop keep up.

Seven stations turn seeds into bags: Security at the door, Seeds, Grow, Harvest, Pack, Orders and Pickup. The game points at whichever one is holding the line up and shows what the next level changes. This is the shop's own upgrade sheet: keep scrolling to walk the line.

A copy of the game's Stations sheet: the bottleneck row, the seven-station strip and the selected station's level, output and upgrade price.

A menu with personality.

Cultivate four strains and choose what to feature. Trends come and go, regulars have favorites, and VIPs tip for the good stuff. This is the shop's real menu: keep scrolling to pick each strain.

Send it out.

Web orders arrive as receipts. Build the delivery pad and a drone lifts off from the roof. Upgrade to bulk dispatch and it carries ten orders at a time, whenever the shelves can cover them. Scroll to send this one.

A copy of the game's Deliveries sheet: orders waiting, flower packed, the next web-order receipt and its Send button, with the auto-drone switch.

One shop becomes a neighborhood.

Open Riverside, Old Town and City Center. Each branch has its own building, projects, stock, staff and a regular who remembers you. They share your cash and keep their own story. Scroll through the stores.

A copy of the game's Empire sheet: the current story chapter, rewards ready to collect, and the three store cards with their level and income.

Lights down. Shop still open.

Switch to night and the work lights, fascia strips and the kiosk sign take over. Pan, pinch and zoom around three floors of glass, timber and plants. It is live Canvas 2D, not a picture: the crew keeps moving while you look. Scroll to close up for the night.

Open the shop

From the first seed to the last handoff.

Start with one shop and a simple loop. Reinvest in the slowest station and the building, the team and the neighborhood grow with you.

  1. SeedsStart a batch
  2. GrowUnder the lights
  3. HarvestCut and cure
  4. PackJars to the shelf
  5. OrdersUp to three counters
  6. PickupBags out the door

A neighborhood of your own.

Three branches, three buildings, three kinds of week. They share your cash while keeping their own management and progression.

Bigger on a desk.

On a laptop the sheet moves aside and the whole cutaway fills the window. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, Space pauses, and 1, 2 and 4 set the speed.

Seven chapters. Three regulars. One block that learns your name.

The story follows your shop from its first ten bags to a network of stores. Mara runs the riverwalk gardening club, Sol has a studio in Old Town, and Kit has one more route to ride. Fill their requests and passing visits turn into something you can count on.

  1. Ch. 1The first familiar faces
  2. Ch. 2A little room to grow
  3. Ch. 3More than the usual
  4. Ch. 4Roots by the river
  5. Ch. 5Someone knows your name
  6. Ch. 6Three corners of the city
  7. Ch. 7Built to belong

Keep it in your pocket.

Canopy is a web app. Add it to your home screen and it opens full-screen like any other game, keeps working offline after the first visit, and picks up where you left off.

iPhone and iPad
In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
Android
In Chrome, open the menu, then Install app.
Desktop
Just play in the browser. Chrome and Edge also offer an install icon in the address bar.
  • Saves on this device, with a backup
  • Welcome-back report, up to twelve hours
  • No account, no server keeping score
21+

A work of fiction. Canopy is a game about running an imaginary dispensary. Nothing here is for sale, and no real product is involved. The game asks players to confirm they are 21 or older before it opens.
